subject.title: Bug:  ignores  config and returns success on media failure

question: Should Feishu support a channel-level `mediaLocalRoots` config key, or should local media sends rely only on the existing generic media access policy and managed staging roots?
rationale: The remaining fix crosses a host file-read boundary and changes Feishu delivery-status semantics, so automation should not choose the permanent security/product contract alone.

options.title: Keep generic media policy and fail fast on local allowlist failures
options.body: Do not add `channels.feishu.mediaLocalRoots`; make local allowlist upload failures terminal or partial with clear CLI output and keep current managed/source-scoped roots as the supported path.

options.title: Add a documented Feishu config root surface
options.body: Accept `channels.feishu.mediaLocalRoots` only with schema/docs/doctor/security tests that define upgrade and local-file-read behavior.

options.title: Document unsupported config and preserve fallback
options.body: Keep the fallback behavior but document that Feishu CLI sends require managed staging roots or generic source-scoped media access, accepting the current partial-delivery semantics.

recommendation.title: Keep generic media policy and fail fast on local allowlist failures
recommendation.body: Do not add `channels.feishu.mediaLocalRoots`; make local allowlist upload failures terminal or partial with clear CLI output and keep current managed/source-scoped roots as the supported path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu media/tool-send work plus adjacent security/config history makes this the best available owner for the boundary decision.
